discrepancies.reference_text: உங்க வயச பார்த்தா கல்யாணம் ஆன மாதிரி தெரியுது.
discrepancies.translation_text: Looking at your face, it looks like you are married.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'looking at your age' (வயச), but the translation says 'looking at your face'.

discrepancies.reference_text: நான் மான்ஸா இப்ப பேசுற மாதிரி மான்ஸா பேசுறேன்.
discrepancies.translation_text: I am single, I am talking to you now.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'I am talking romantically' (ரொமான்ஸா/மான்ஸா), but the translation says 'I am single'.

discrepancies.reference_text: செக்ஸ் பண்ணதுல செக்ஸ் தவிர வேற எல்லாம் பண்ணிருக்கேன்.
discrepancies.translation_text: I didn't do anything except kissing.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'I haven't done sex, but I have done everything else except sex', whereas the translation says 'I didn't do anything except kissing'.

discrepancies.reference_text: உங்களை கற்பனை பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கேன் நான். எப்படி இருப்பீங்கன்னு.
discrepancies.translation_text: I am doing a video call to you, how are you?
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'I am imagining you, how you would be', but the translation says 'I am doing a video call to you'.

discrepancies.reference_text: நான் இப்பதான் சொன்னேன் வீடியோ கால்ல பேச பேச நார்மல் கால்ல பேச வேணாம் பேசலாம்னு சொன்னேனே.
discrepancies.translation_text: I just told you, I will talk on video call, I said I will talk on normal call, if you want, talk.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'I just said we don't need to talk on video call, we can talk on normal call', but the translation incorrectly says 'I will talk on video call'.

discrepancies.translation_text: I am in a maroon color.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'I am of wheatish/dusky complexion' (மாநிற), but the translation says 'maroon color'.

discrepancies.reference_text: நீங்க அமௌன்ட் போடுறேன்னா சொல்லுங்க நான் நம்பர் கொடுக்கிறேன் முதல்ல போடுங்க.
discrepancies.translation_text: If you want to put a number, tell me, I will give the number, first put it.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'If you are going to transfer the amount, tell me', but the translation says 'If you want to put a number'.

discrepancies.reference_text: நீங்க எப்படி இருப்பீங்கன்னு பார்த்து நான் பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கேன்.
discrepancies.translation_text: I am looking at how you are and doing it.
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'I am imagining how you would look and doing it (masturbating)', but the translation says 'I am looking at how you are'.

discrepancies.reference_text: உங்க கூட படுக்கணும் போல இருக்கு வரியா?
discrepancies.translation_text: You feel like sleeping with me, right?
discrepancies.explanation: The reference is a direct proposition/question 'I feel like sleeping with you, are you coming?', but the translation turns it into a question about the other person's feelings.

summary: The translation captures the general flow of the call, but contains several critical errors regarding the negotiation of payments, sexual acts (masturbation), and direct propositions.
